name: himeno3
description: Himeno benchmark (RIKEN C+MPI v3.0, GiOMP port): point-Jacobi solve of the pressure Poisson equation, XL grid (513 x 513 x 1025), 1000 iterations, split over the ranks in I. Each iteration runs the 19-point sweep (with the residual's sum reduction), the residual's MPI_Allreduce, the copy P = wrk2, then puts one 2.1 MB I plane to each neighbour and fences. The compiler can move those puts into the copy kernel. One GH200 per rank, 3 nodes (the middle rank has two cross-node neighbours). Time is the measured loop; the program also prints the time of each phase.

OMP_NUM_TEAMS.note: teams per kernel for every launch; 0 lets the runtime pick

OMP_TEAMS_THREAD_LIMIT.note: threads per team, at least a warp; unset lets the runtime pick

OMPX_PIPE_COUNT_MIN_LOG2.note: puts smaller than 2^n bytes to a cross-node peer wait for the next quiet instead of being sent by the kernel
